### The Gift of Precious Providential Thornbushes
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/the-gift-of-precious-providential-thornbushes/
Passage: Hosea 2:6-7
Points:
- Uncomfortable providences and obstacles serve as merciful gifts from God.
- Christ persistently pursues believers whenever their hearts wander toward idols.
- God's hedging thorns keep His people from running to false comforts.
- Divine jealousy reflects Christ's deep, impassioned love for His bride.
- God frustrates pursuit of lesser loves to bring His people home.
